Layout

A layout where 41% of the land is roads, parks and green.

The HMDA layout has 252 plots on 30, 40 and 60 ft roads, ten parks, social infrastructure and a green belt. Here is how the net site area of 158,483 sq yd is divided.

  • Plotted area55.92%
  • Roads33.08%
  • Parks7.52%
  • Social infrastructure2.51%
  • Utility area0.51%
  • Green belt0.46%

Scroll or drag the plan to look closer. Scale 1:1000, as shown in the approved layout.

Location

Close to the city. Far from the noise.

The site is in the Vikarabad corridor beside the Ananthagiri forest belt. The Outer Ring Road connects it to every side of Hyderabad.

  • 10min
    Vikarabad TownLocal markets and daily needs

Amenities & resort

Earth Retreat: a forest resort for owners.

The Living Sanctuary sits at the south-eastern tip of the site, where the pond and stream meet the forest boundary. Arrival, dining, wellness and forest walks are planned as one sequence.

  • Glass-walled reception and restaurant
  • Pool with extended lawn
  • Yoga pavilion
  • Amphi seating and a gentle mount
  • Campfire circle and terraced lawns
  • Kids' park in a forest zone
  • Site-wide trails and stepped paths
  • Wide tree-lined internal roads
  • Security cabin and gated arrival
  • Parks and social infrastructure
